prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Find an object, take and check it's properties, then move to location or perform specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObjectProperties
		DO MoveToLocation
		DO SpecificTask
	END
